title: Mali : les projets SanDi et EMU lancés pour améliorer la santé publique
why_not: Reports the 15 October 2025 launch of the Spanish-financed SanDi solar energy and digital health project (990,099 euros, July 2025 to December 2026; Kayes, Sikasso, Bandiagara) but names no patient record or other system, so it states no EMR fact.
